{{Quote|These Corellians are something, aren't they? Bomb their cities and they come right back and blow up your shuttle. Miles of heart, these people. Bought themselves a world of hurt, but darned if they haven't earned my respect! Now the Selonians, them I could do without. Vicious, feral things, killing with tooth and claw. Probably crawling with diseases, too.|Lord Kanno|<ref name="Sewer Rats">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Sewer Rats|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Kanno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He had a [[Kanno's daughter|daughter]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and considered bringing a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] as a pet to her.<ref name="Ambient" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Selonians fancy themselves warriors, but they fight like beasts, leaving only pieces of our soldiers behind. One pack in particular has taken special delight in savaging my troops. I need someone to find these strays and put them down. [...] Exterminate them like the vermin they are.|Lord Kanno recruited an Empire-aligned individual to punish hostile Selonians|<ref name="Sewer Rats" />}}
In [[3640 BBY]], Kanno was among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that [[Battle of Corellia|invaded]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under the leadership of [[Darth Decimus]]. When a group of [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] warriors in [[Axial Park]] began to threaten the Imperial occupation forces there, Kanno recruited an Imperial hero to assault their warren and eradicate the natives.<ref name="Sewer Rats" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'd enjoy this fine Corellian air a whole lot more if it wasn't tainted by the stench of Selonian fur.|Lord Kanno was prejudiced against Selonians|<ref name="Sewer Rats" />}}
Kanno was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who held prejudiced views against Selonians, frequently referring them as "strays" as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] saw their staunch stance against Imperial intrusion and their warrior's ways as savagery.<ref name="Sewer Rats" />
